notes.title: Grapple 2.0.2 (I missed)
notes.content:
First off, I'm sorry.

It's impossible to please everyone with a game, especially one with as much hype as this. When making the 2.2 update I talked to speedrunners and tried to take as little away from the existing game as possible, while still making it accessible to newcomers.

Some suggestions I heard:
- Nobody likes the music
- The Physics are too hard for beginners
- The animations make hitboxes harder to see, and make speedrunning harder

Some suggestions I've heard since V2:
- The game feels unfinished there's no music
- The Physics are too easy for speedrunners
- The game feels unfinished there's no animations

Here's the changes I've made:
- I've reverted the physics back to pre-2.0
- I've added in some of the old sound effects

I'm planning to make the old version playable. All runs are archived while we figure out the best way to do that.

Anyway, I missed. My motivations for doing this update to begin with was to make the community happy. If it weren't for them I wouldn't have made the new maps to begin with, so I want to make sure I get this right. If you have any suggestions please join our discord and ping me anytime

https://discord.gg/ErAhEpsxUe

- Barji
